remarks: Location, location! Find your home at the lovely Buckingham complex, situated at a perfectly convenient corner central to Stamford's vibrant downtown, shopping districts, golf courses, and schools. Just minutes from the Metro-North station and major highways. Have your every need met with The Buckingham's plentiful amenities - assigned garage parking with plenty of visitor parking, an in-ground pool, a large scale fitness room with a sauna, a designated library/study room, a community room, a beautifully updated front lobby, and a 24 hour doorman. Step inside the move-in ready unit to enjoy the open floor plan: An oversized livingroom and dining area with a sliding glass door leading out to your own private balcony to overlook the cityscape. A recently remodeled kitchen with potential space for a breakfast nook. And a hallway leading to two spacious bedrooms with deep walk-in closets, as well as two full baths. Washer/dryer, most windows, water heater, and electric panel are all newer (apprx. last 5 years). Nothing to do but move right in and enjoy the Stamford convenience and lifestyle!
